english.note: This is the all-purpose choice for something primordial, from an early era, or generally primitive rather than modern.
Use this all-purpose choice for the primitive or earliest-original sense, rather than for a specific indigenous population.
Choose this when primeval means primitive or undeveloped, rather than simply old.

examples.english: This primitive tribal culture is still very well preserved today.
examples.traditional: 呢種原始部落文化到而家仲保留得好完整。
